content.text:
Two Important findings; no Critical findings.

1. **Interrupted requests can claim complete usage.** [nova/agent.py:446](/Users/markcastillo/git/nova-agent/nova/agent.py:446) catches only `Exception` when recording missing request usage. A `KeyboardInterrupt` during a subsequent provider request bypasses that accounting; `_execute_run` publishes a cancelled terminal result with `usage.complete=True` based only on earlier requests. This can also expose an apparently complete reported/estimated cost. Reproduced using one successful actual provider call followed by `KeyboardInterrupt` in the next call. Record missing usage for interrupted attempts while preserving callback exception behavior.

2. **Nonstream partial output disappears on failure.** [nova/agent.py:616](/Users/markcastillo/git/nova-agent/nova/agent.py:616) collects partial output exclusively through the streaming callback; [line 685](/Users/markcastillo/git/nova-agent/nova/agent.py:685) uses that buffer for failures. With `stream=False`, a response containing `"Important partial findings"` plus a tool call, followed by provider failure, returns failed `output=""`. Retain observed assistant content independently of whether streaming is enabled.

Minor / existing behavior exposed:

- [nova/agent.py:864](/Users/markcastillo/git/nova-agent/nova/agent.py:864) retries context-overflow errors even after streamed text was delivered, bypassing `_call_llm`’s retry safeguard. A mocked stream emitting `"partial"` then raising `"maximum context length exceeded"` runs twice and emits duplicate deltas. The outer retry behavior predates this slice, so I would not block Task 1 on it without an explicit no-replay requirement.

Validation: all **84 focused existing tests passed**. The command failed only on the repositorywide coverage floor applied to this subset. Three disposable regression probes reproduced the findings above. No tracked files changed.

Declined to judge: Task 2 limits, session locks, deadlines, process cleanup, approval stopping semantics; Task 3 machine CLI; standalone `run_task`; paid-provider/live acceptance. Its deliberate omission does not constitute a finding.

Review disposition: **2 Important findings and 1 Minor finding, all addressed** by your reported regression tests and fixes. No Critical findings.

No further review performed. Task 2/3 functionality, standalone `run_task`, and live acceptance remain outside this review.
